text:
CIDS
 

永續創新民主研究中心
 

Centre for Innovative Democracy and Sustainability (CIDS)
 

 

認識CIDS
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

當創新民主遇上永續，觸發無限可能！我們相信，「創新民主」是深化民主的重要進程，並希望將這一理念推廣到更多需要串連的角落。創新民主中心（CID）於2019年成立，致力於打造一個促進創新公共溝通的團隊，協助各方跨越既定成見，並貢獻智慧，解決社會難題。2023年接續原政大第三部門研究中心深化民主、壯大地方草根公民社會的使命，共同轉型為永續創新民主研究中心（Centre for Innovative Democracy and Sustainability, CIDS）。中心英文縮寫中的S代表永續價值取向，也有代表複數個創新民主地方實踐的意涵，結合永續發展目標，探索科技民主化的未來可能性。跟著CIDS一起，為台灣創造更具活力與韌性的民主與永續未來！
 

我們的使命！
 

 

強化參與式治理
 

致力於建立堅實的民主基礎建設，推動研究、實踐與教育，厚植公民社會韌性。
 

 

培養未來人才
 

從CIDS到CIDers，專注於跨領域溝通與政策分析人才養成，打造多元合作的知識網絡。
 

創新民主中心（CIDS）：打造公共溝通新典範！
 

在科技與社會的交界，CIDS致力於知識轉譯與公民共創，聚焦核廢料選址、石化工業公正轉型等關鍵科技民主議題。CIDS是「知識中介者」、「社會信任的橋樑」，也是「跨領域政策的推動者」，在充滿挑戰與爭議的場域中，研發創新的公共參與和科技溝通模式。從設計前沿的審議方法，到促進不同社群之間的深度對話，CIDS推動更多可能，打造連結各方的參與式治理新典範。
 

 

科技、民主與社會研究中心（DSET）：

守護台灣民主的堅實後盾！
 

CIDS秉持連結韌性民主與永續治理的初衷，獲國科會支持推動國際型科技地緣政治智庫-DSET計畫，應對當前全球複雜且動盪的局勢。面對地緣政治的挑戰與科技迅速發展對民主與經濟安全的衝擊，DSET以「跨國界、跨領域、跨世代」為三大核心使命，提供深入的人文社會觀點，推動科技研發與產業政策的創新建議。
 

 

培養皿計劃
 

CIDS 正在推行的計畫目標，值得您加入！
 

 

 

 

 

 

社會對話
 

CIDS 致力於民主素養的社會共創，建構以「議題」為出發的社會對話框架，與社群夥伴進行有意義的對話與合作，共同創造民主參與的途徑。我們提供多元的課程和審議活動，應用於教育體系、公共博物館、地方社區和公私部門員工，試圖拉近政策與社會需求之間的距離，促進更具包容性和回應性的公共決策。
 

國際對接
 

CIDS 與 DSET 合力推動「國際科技智庫外交」，以非官方角色參與國際對話，透過循證的政策論述與國際智庫互動。CIDS 同時重視國際學術交流與論述拓展，中心主任亦曾經擔任 [EASTS《東亞科技與社會研究國際期刊》](https://www.easts-journal.com/)國際期刊主編，與科技與社會（STS）核心期刊的編委。傳遞台灣科技與社會研究與政策經驗至國際學術與政策社群，透過學術發展與知識交流，促進新興科技政策的雙向對話與合作。
 

 

 

青年營隊
 

CIDS 致力於推動永續民主的世代工程，依據真實的政策框架，為青年提供參與政策形成的情境。透過場景設計、角色代言等建構出沙盒試驗，為青年創造模擬實際操作的機會，讓他們在真實的政策環境中學習與經驗。這不僅可激發對民主的熱情，也培養不同世代的民主人才，確保永續民主在當代社會中得以永續發展。
 

 

社區共學
 

CIDS 致力於地方永續轉型的實務推動，協助制定因地制宜的行動方案，並有效對接政策工具。強調與地方社區的連結與同步，目前已與文山社大、屏南社大、北高社大在不同議題上合作。促進居民與地方政府共同規劃與擬定行動，確保轉型過程更貼近地方需求，並可持續帶來社會效益。
 

 

永續校園
 

CIDS 作為政治大學校級研究中心，與校方共同思考永續校園發展的任務。我們特別聚焦於「校園飲食永續」，預計與校內餐廳「對味廚房料理實驗室」連結校內外單位及周邊節點合作，持續推動相關議題，期望將校園打造為飲食永續的示範基地，實現長期的永續飲食效益，以提升教職員及學生身心健康。
 

 

核心團隊
 

 

杜文苓 | 中心主任
 

📨wtu@nccu.edu.tw
 

現職為政治大學公共行政學系特聘教授，兼任創新國際學院院長、永續創新民主研究中心主任、國科會科技民主與社會研究中心主任。

目前亦擔任總統府全社會防衛韌性委員會委員、經濟部放射性廢棄物處置專案辦公室主任、行政法人國家太空中心董事、國家人權委員會諮詢顧問、中華電信基金會董事。曾任東亞科技與社會期刊（EASTS）國際期刊主編。

Welcome to cids.nccu.edu.tw (hereinafter referred to as “the Website”)! You are welcome to share the materials posted on this website via links. If you need to reproduce, copy, or distribute the website’s materials, please contact the Website and obtain written consent before proceeding. To ensure you can use the services provided by this Website with greater peace of mind, we hereby explain the Website’s information security policy as follows:

Scope of Policy Application

The following privacy policy applies to the collection, use, and protection of personal data involved in your activities on this Website. However, it does not apply to websites of government agencies, other organizations, groups, or individuals that are linked to the functionalities of this Website. Each website linked through this Website, regardless of whether it is operated or managed by this Website, has its own exclusive privacy policy. This Website does not assume any joint responsibility. When you engage in activities on these websites, the protection of personal data is governed by the respective privacy policies of those websites.

Collection and Use of Personal Data

Simply browsing this Website and downloading files does not involve the collection of any personal identity information. When using various online application services provided by this Website, if personal data is required, the relevant units handling the case will ask you to provide the most current and accurate information, such as your name, ID number, contact phone number, email address, and mailing address, based on the needs of the case.

The data collected by this Website will be used for specific purposes, such as government information disclosure (073), file management, and marketing (040). If there is a need to use the data beyond these purposes, we will obtain your consent before proceeding.

If you provide feedback or inquire about relevant business issues through email or service mailboxes, we will keep a record of the communication, but it will only be used to contact you.

This Website is obligated to protect the privacy of each applicant and will not independently modify or delete any personal data or files without obtaining your consent first. However, the following exceptions apply:

Violation of this Website’s regulations, such as posting abusive or personally attacking comments in the forum.

Protecting or defending the rights or ownership of relevant individuals.

To protect the rights of the units related to this Website, this Website will never arbitrarily provide, sell, exchange, or rent any personal data to other groups, individuals, or private enterprises, except in the following circumstances:

Cooperation with legal investigations by judicial units.

Cooperation with relevant authorities for investigations or usage as needed for their duties.

When it is in good faith and reasonably believed that such disclosure is required by law or is used for the maintenance and improvement of website services in related management operations.

Personal data collected by this Website will be deleted after the retention period, according to legal requirements and business needs.

Use of Cookies

To provide you with the best possible service, this Website records user IP addresses, browsing times, and pages viewed on the site (commonly known as Cookies). These data are used for analyzing overall user behavior and browsing habits through Google Analytics to improve the quality of services on this Website. Rest assured, this Website does not analyze individual user behavior. If you do not wish to accept the use of Cookies, you can set the privacy level to high in the settings of your browser, which will reject the use of Cookies. However, this may result in some features of this Website not functioning properly.

Rights of Data Subjects

Regarding the personal data collected through the various online application services provided by this Website, you have the right to exercise the following rights under Article 3 of the Personal Data Protection Act, except as restricted by laws and regulations. To exercise these rights, please contact us to apply:

Inquire or request to review.

Request a copy of the data.

Request to supplement or correct the data.

Request to cease the collection, processing, or use of the data.

Request deletion of the data.

Information Security and Protection

This Website’s server is protected by a firewall to prevent illegal intrusion, destruction, or data theft. When you use the various service functions of this Website, any data stored on this Website will be fully protected to ensure the security of personal information.

Self-Protection Measures for Personal Data Security

Please take good care of your personal information and do not provide it to any third parties to protect your rights. Be aware that any personal information disclosed on the internet (such as in forums, message boards, or chat areas) may be collected and used by others, potentially leading to unsolicited emails from others.

Copyright Statement

All content published on cids.nccu.edu.tw (hereinafter referred to as “the Website”) is protected by copyright law, except for materials not subject to copyright under the law (such as laws, orders, official speeches, press releases, etc.—please refer to Article 9 of the Copyright Act for details). Other content, including text, photography, images, audio recordings, videos, and other information, is protected by copyright law.

Materials not subject to copyright can be freely used by anyone and are encouraged for widespread use.

For content on this Website that is protected by copyright law, use is only allowed with the permission or authorization of the copyright holder, unless it falls under fair use as prescribed by law.

The “fair use under the law” is explained as follows:

Works published in the name of this Website, where the author is the Website itself, may be linked or transmitted within a reasonable scope. Please indicate the source when providing links.

Information on this Website can be reproduced for non-profit purposes for personal or family use.

For reporting, commentary, teaching, research, or other legitimate purposes, this Website’s information may be quoted within a reasonable scope. Please indicate the source when quoting.
